actions.name: aetheria.open_ship
actions.doc: Read the ship's .cc into the layout buffer (binds the collection from the Ship .cc field when it is not bound yet). Replaces the buffer; one undo step.

fields.name: collection
fields.doc: the ship collection's name; empty means the active object's collection

actions.name: aetheria.push_ship
actions.doc: Dry-run the layout buffer against the ship's .cc: the result lists the changes Apply would write. Writes nothing.

fields.name: collection
fields.doc: the ship collection's name; empty means the active object's collection
